rationale: The long thesis remains mechanically intact: SPEM has absorbed the -1.5% gap down and is holding above both session VWAP ($51.87) and the 9-EMA ($51.99), coiling just 7bps under the day's high ($52.06) with a tight 1.9bp spread, and the $51.84 invalidation is untouched — leaving defined risk of roughly $37 against a ~$75 target to $52.42. Flipping short would fight the intraday recovery structure with no distribution evidence, and closing forfeits a constructive setup that has merely gone sideways, not wrong. Confidence is modest because 40 minutes of flat P&L with fading volume into the highs and a soft tape (SPY -0.27%, VIXY +1.19%) offer no fresh confirmation either way.
